text:
lodash is bumped to 4.17.21 (from 4.17.15), but the tests don't pass: 3 fail in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` (DST boundary in America/New_York, parsing local midnight, month-end rollover in local tz).

The failures are probably unrelated to lodash. They are timezone-dependent, and the same 3 failed after `git stash`. That baseline isn't conclusive, though:
- `node_modules` still held 4.17.21 during the stash run, so the code was never tested against the old lodash.
- The working directory reports as not a git repo, and the stash/pop output showed no confirmation, so I can't be sure the stash did anything. Check that `package.json` and the lockfile still show 4.17.21.

I also didn't check the registry, so I haven't confirmed 4.17.21 is the latest. Run `npm view lodash version` to be sure.

To confirm the failures are environmental, run `TZ=America/New_York npm test`, or check whether the spec assumes a specific timezone. I haven't changed the date tests.
